title: ADXL34x
text: Measure linear acceleration along axes of ADXL34x family of accelerometers, 1 output, {Accelerometer range} sets Full scale for measuring linear acceleration; {I2C module} sets the module for communication, {I2C address}, {Data type} sets the output data type for values from ADXL34x sensor, {Sample time} sets the time interval to read data, {Accelerometer output data rate} sets the rate at which accelerometer data is sampled, {Enable data ready interrupt} enables interrupt when data is ready and {Interrupt generate pin} sets the pin to generate data ready. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Acceleration
ports.summary: Linear acceleration measured by ADXL34x sensor vector

params.name: Data type
params.values: Output data type for values from ADXL34x sensor single (default) | double

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Time interval to read data -1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Accelerometer range
params.values: Full scale for measuring linear acceleration ±4g (default) | ±2g | ±8g | ±16g

params.name: Accelerometer output data rate
params.values: Rate at which accelerometer data is sampled 12.5 Hz (default) | 0.1 Hz | 0.2 Hz | 0.39 Hz | 0.78 Hz | 1.56 Hz | 3.13 Hz | 6.25 Hz | 25 Hz | 50 Hz | 100 Hz | 200 Hz | 400 Hz | 800 Hz | 1600 Hz

params.name: Enable data ready interrupt
params.values: Enable interrupt when data is ready off (default) | on

params.name: Interrupt generate pin
params.values: Pin to generate data ready interrupt INT1 (default) | INT2
